synopsis: The glossary identifies Daimler heavy trucks as one of four manufacturers represented in the booklet’s NHTSA unnecessary-braking investigation record; the detailed Daimler precedent concerns Detroit Assurance AEB in on-road trucks [f15428, f1811]. The investigation opened as PE23-010 in May 2023 after NHTSA reproduced hard braking on a steel trench plate [f1226, f1508, f1812]. NHTSA upgraded it to engineering analysis EA25-006 in October 2025, with reports of 24 crashes, 13 injuries and one fatality [f1510]. Daimler disputed whether the reproduction represented real-world risk, but NHTSA upgraded the case anyway [f1511, f1967]. The engineering analysis remained open in October 2025 and its outcome was uncertain; although the case draws on independent regulator and press evidence, what had been validated was not published, limiting its use as a validation precedent [f1814, f1962, f1815, f1811].
